# GECCO Workshop on Real-Parameter Black-Box Optimization Benchmarking (BBOB 2015)

The 5th GECCO Workshop on Real-Parameter
Black-Box Optimization Benchmarking (BBOB 2015) took place
during GECCO 2015 in Madrid, Spain.



## Previous Web Page
You can find the previous webpage for this workshop at the 
[Internet Archive](https://web.archive.org/web/20200811020539/https://coco.gforge.inria.fr/doku.php?id=bbob-2015).



## Workshop Schedule


  | **Session I**                               | Sunday, July 12, 2015, Patio 3                                                                                                           |
  |---------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
  | The BBOBies                                 | Introduction to the BBOB Framework                                                                                                       |
  | Petr Pošik, Petr Baudiš                     | Dimension Selection in Axis-Parallel Brent-STEP Method for Black-Box Optimization of Separable Continuous Functions                      |
  | Asma Atamna                                 | Benchmarking IPOP-CMA-ES-TPA and IPOP-CMA-ES-MSR on the BBOB Noiseless Testbed                                                           |  

  | **Session II**                              | Sunday, July 12, Patio 3                                                                                                                 |
  |---------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
  | Lukaš Bajer, Zbynek Pitra, Martin Holena    | Benchmarking Gaussian Processes and Random Forsts Surrogate Models on the BBOB Noiseless Testbed                                         |
  | Dimo Brockhoff, Bernd Bischl, Tobias Wagner | The Impact of Initial Designs on the Performance of MATSuMoTo on the Noiseless BBOB-2015 Testbed: A Preliminary Study                    |
